objective: Start in Frozen Heights, pick your starter and take the first rival fight; head east.
Walk Route 1 north; first wild encounters of the run.
Heal and look around Bellin Town; the gentleman here hands out a one-off gift Pokemon (Glameow, Skorupi or Stunky).
note: Gift choice counts as an encounter for Nuzlocke purposes - decide with your partner.

objective: Cross Icicle Cave and fight the rival again at the far end.
Continue along Route 2 toward Dresco Town; clear all trainers if you want the Litleo reward.
Reach Dresco Town, heal and prepare for the first gym.
Beat the first gym.
Go east to Route 3 and on through Flower Paradise and Grim Woods.
Pass through Flower Paradise (Pokemon are tied to flowers and time) toward Grim Woods.
Work through Grim Woods to reach Route 4.
Continue on Route 4 toward the volcano.
Cinder Volcano story fight with the Shadow Admins on the way to Route 5.
confidence: wiki + nuzlocke.data order; boss names from wiki search, medium confidence

objective: Cross Route 5 to Crater Town (a Unovan starter house sits on this route).
Reach Crater Town, heal; second gym is here.
Beat the second gym.
unlock: Badge 2 (Vision Badge: lets you use Cut outside battle)

objective: Walk into the KBT Expressway entrance south of Crater Town: a cutscene throws you into a fight and afterwards a mountain climber hands you Cut.
note: Needs the gym badge first; the expressway then works as a fast-travel hub for later towns.

objective: Go through Valley Cave to Route 6.
Route 6 then 7: keep heading toward Frost Mountain.
Route 7 leads to Frost Mountain.
Cross Frost Mountain; the rival fights you again here.
Route 8 down to Blizzard City.
Heal in Blizzard City; the mountain climber in the house next to the expressway entrance gives Rock Smash.
Optional Frozen Forest detour for the extra encounters, then back for the gym.
Beat the third gym.
unlock: Badge 3 (Wings Badge: lets you use Rock Smash outside battle)

objective: Head to Fallshore City by the expressway; its gym leader is not at home.
note: Mel is hiding in Tehl Town and has to be brought back, per pokecoders.

objective: Route 11 leads to Epidimy Town; take Strength there.
Visit the west-most house in Epidimy Town for Strength.
unlock: HM04 Strength (usable after the Fall Badge)
note: Story counter 0x500C lists Tehl Town and Route 9 (5–6), then Fallshore (8), before the first Epidimy value (9). Another Epidimy value (15) sits between Thundercap and Tarmigan. That order is uncertain, so this step stays where the wiki puts it.

objective: Routes 10 and 9 take you to Tehl Town.
Find Mel in Tehl Town (and deal with the Shadow Admin there), then send him back to his gym.
confidence: pokecoders HM guide; boss medium confidence

objective: Beat Mel in his inverse-battle gym, then take Fly from him outside.
Climb Thundercap Mountain (level-up spot for Magneton/Nosepass/Charjabug) toward Tarmigan Town.
Tarmigan Town: heal, then take on the mansion.
Clear the mansion; beating Maxima raises the level cap (43 vanilla / 45 difficult).
note: This gives the ability to Mega Evolve; progress is gated by the rival on Route 12 afterwards.

objective: Rival fight on Route 12 after you gain Mega Evolution; he gives you Surf afterwards.
unlock: HM03 Surf (use outside battle needs Battery Badge)

objective: Dehara City: heal; the Shadow quest line starts at the Ruins of Void.
note: Game Corner (story counter 0x500C = 22) is optional and unverified. It is not a required stop.

objective: Clear Ruins of Void, then the Shadow base under Cinder Volcano, before the gym.
boss: Ruin Agent Vega; later Shadow Boss Zeph
confidence: wiki walkthrough order, boss names low-medium confidence
note: Cube Space (story counter 0x500C 36–37) is optional and unverified. A map section points at Cube Corp. only as a guess.

objective: Beat the fifth gym (double battle).
confidence: gym list; type from wiki/cross-reference search

objective: After badge 5, Routes 13 and 14 plus Auburn Waterway lead to the Lost Tunnel and the Great Desert.
Lost Tunnel links Auburn Waterway to the expressway; keep going west to the desert.
Cross the Great Desert to Gurun Town (fossils can be dug up here).
Gurun Town: heal, then take the route towards Vivill Woods.
Walk through Vivill Woods to Vivill Town.
Vivill Town: warehouse story.
Fight through Vivill Warehouse.
Route 16 leads to Antisis City.
Antisis Sewers storyline before the gym.
Beat the sixth gym.
Route 17: a construction worker gives Rock Climb.
note: Wiki says Route 17, pkmnunbound.com says Route 16 - contradiction.

objective: Pass through Distortion World (story counter 0x500C 58–68, ending at Rift Cave) on the way to Seaport.
note: Likely gap between Vivill Warehouse and Seaport. Antisis does not appear in that counter, so those steps stay in the wiki order and this step is only placed before Seaport.

objective: Seaport City, then Polder Town by ferry/route.
Beat the seventh gym; Tessy gives Waterfall.
Cootes Bog then Magnolia Town (rival fights again).
Crystal Peak story fights, then Magnolia Fields to Redwood Village.
confidence: wiki walkthrough, boss list low confidence

objective: Beat the eighth gym.
Route 18 and Victory Road to the Pokemon League.
Elite Four, then Champion Jax. After that the level caps are removed and Dive can be bought.
unlock: HM05 Dive (post-game, buy from Captain Davy in Seaport City)
